decisions.reason: As a flagship stollen closely based on existing expertise and externally confirmed by a gold medal, strong absorptive capacity makes withdrawal very unlikely.
Dark barley malt rye bread draws directly on the firm's established bread-making knowledge, so it can read early results and refine the product rather than drop it.
Marzipan stollen is close to the firm's existing stollen offer, allowing the firm to use its prior knowledge to evaluate and improve the product.
